newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian GDP grew 0.5 pct in Q3 vs Q2 - Prodi.
newsitem.headline: Italian GDP grew 0.5 pct in Q3 vs Q2 - Prodi.

text.p: Italy's gross domestic product (GDP) grew 0.5 percent in the third quarter of 1996 compared with the second quarter, Prime Minister Romano Prodi said in a speech on Wednesday.
"This makes one think that the most negative period for the economy is now past," Prodi told a conference organised by the Italian federation of agricultural employers.
Italy's GDP grew 0.7 percent year-on-year in the second quarter of 1996 but fell 0.4 percent by comparison with the first quarter of the year.
Preliminary GDP data from the third quarter is due at the end of next month.

Prodi said average daily industrial production fell 2.3 percent between March and May compared with the previous three-month period and rose 0.3 percent between June and August. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
